image_description: A close-up photograph of a vehicle's disk brake assembly. The main subject is a large, circular metal rotor with cross-drilled holes and curved grooves on its surface. A red caliper is mounted on the right side of the rotor. The rotor is attached to a wheel hub with visible lug bolt holes. The background is dark, suggesting a garage or workshop setting.
